column1: Number of Code Blocks per Subframe (Note 3)

Note 1:For TDD mode, in line with TS 36.331, Uplink-Downlink Configuration 5 is proposed, up to 5 subframes (#3/4/7/8/9) are available for MBMS.Note 2:2 OFDM symbols are reserved for PDCCH; reference signal allocated as per TS 36.211.Note 3:If more than one Code Block is present, an additional CRC sequence of L = 24 Bits is attached to each Code Block (otherwise L = 0 Bit).
